title: The Bull Market Is Back? New Onchain Metas & the GTA VI Hack
summary: In this episode of Galaxy Grid, the hosts break down the massive market rally as Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, and altcoins print green candles across the board. The crew analyzes the factors driving the rip, including massive ETF inflows, short covering, and the SEC's new tokenization startup exemption that creates a lawful path for sub-$5M ICOs. Next, they dive into the evolving onchain landscape, highlighting how the FOMO app is solving crypto's UX problem with Apple Pay onboarding and true chain abstraction, while Robinhood Chain pioneers new meme-coin-to-equity AMM models. Finally, the hosts unpack the wild story of "CyberLeak"—a hacker group utilizing a cypherpunk stack of Solana meme coins, Monero, and Arweave permanent storage to leak Grand Theft Auto 6 assets and fund their operations.
